title: Reuse, Watched
summary: The leaked-hash, reused-password chain from Reuse and Reuse, with a watcher on the second server. Cracking happens offline and makes no noise; it is the live steps against the target you must keep quiet.
story: Copperline Freight (made up) is watching app02 on 10.10.8.0/24. Grab the hash dump from the first server, crack it offline, and use the reused password on the watched server - without a loud scan, failed sign-ins or guessing against it. You start on scout.
goal: Capture both flags on app02 the quiet way and keep the full quiet bonus.
skills: quiet recon, reading a leaked backup, offline cracking, a reused password, a set-user-ID program

hints.text: The crack is offline - it makes no noise at all. Do your loud-looking work (reading the backup) on the FIRST server; the watcher only cares about app02. Scan app02 just once (nmap -sV 10.10.8.30) and sign in with the cracked password - one clean login.
Never run pwguess against app02: you already have the password from the crack, so use it. A set-user-ID program on app02 reads root's flag - find / -perm -4000.
Order: webscan/read the backup on web01, hashcrack it, ssh renter@10.10.8.30 with the cracked password, then the set-user-ID reader. Only the login touches the watched box.
